messages:
ajay: Heads-up: nightly eval CI started failing on runner after metric rename change. Error shows mismatch in metrics contract. Anyone else seeing this?
maria: saw it, triaging now. failing job: https://ci.redwood.com/job/5234
ci-bot: Job 5234 finished — 11 failed tests, 6 warnings.
ajay: core failure is in eval-reporter mapping: we expected 'latency_ms' but new harness emits 'mean_latency_ms'
samir: that's from my PR where I unified metric names for clarity. I missed the CI mapping update, sorry.
eva: sample failure snippet:
```
AssertionError: missing keys in reported_metrics: ['latency_ms']
Reported: {'mean_latency_ms': 12.3, 'tp_s': 45.1, 'cost_per_token_usd': 0.00012}
Expected schema: ['latency_ms','throughput','cost_per_token_usd']
```
maria: two issues: 1) runner should emit both legacy name + new name (temporary shim) or 2) report-contract test in CI should be updated alongside PR
ajay: sounds right. We should avoid breaking dashboards. The dashboard panels rely on 'throughput' and 'latency_ms'
perf-bot: nightly-eval: model "zeta-v2" throughput dropped 7% — filed ticket #INC-889
samir: I'll push a quick shim that maps mean_latency_ms->latency_ms and tp_s->throughput for now, and open a follow-up to standardize names.
ci-bot: Patch set uploaded: change-id Iabcd1234. Running tests.
eva: also, let's add a lint rule in eval runner that verifies reporting schema against infra/eval/metrics_contract.json
maria: where to put that contract? suggest repo path infra/eval/metrics_contract.json and CI step `check-metrics-contract`
ajay: add tolerance on p95 naming too; dashboards read 'decode_p95_ms' we might need aliasing.
samir: fixed, shim merged. CI green for reporter tests. Will create a docs PR explaining the canonical names and a migration plan.
opsalicia: please add an alert if metrics keys change in production reporter for 24h
ajay: thanks all. follow-ups: samir to open migration RFC, maria to add CI check, opsalicia to add alert. Closing thread when doc PR links are up.
